name: Tiny Math
why_it_works: Big goals feel impossible, but small numbers feel doable. Showing the plain arithmetic of a tiny daily or weekly habit makes the outcome feel inevitable instead of heroic, and doing the math in front of the viewer earns more trust than a slogan ever could.

hook.pattern: Open with one small, oddly specific number and promise to show what it adds up to.
examples: {{small_unit}} a day. Watch it add up.
Do the math on {{small_unit}} with me.

variables.name: small_unit
variables.description: The tiny daily or weekly amount

variables.name: habit

slides.headline: {{small_unit}} sounds like nothing
slides.visual_prompt: Big bold numeral card, warm off-white background, {{brand}} accent color, minimal

slides.headline: One week
slides.visual_prompt: Seven small identical objects in a row on a wooden table, top-down, soft daylight

slides.headline: One year
slides.visual_prompt: A tall neat stack of the same small objects, side light, shallow depth of field

slides.headline: Put another way
slides.visual_prompt: Calendar with many days quietly checked off in pencil, soft natural light

slides.headline: Big change is small math
slides.body: You don't need a new life. You need {{small_unit}}.
slides.visual_prompt: Bold type card in {{brand}} colors, lots of negative space

slides.headline: Start with one day
slides.visual_prompt: Clean lifestyle photo of {{habit}}, early evening light, vertical 4:5, {{brand}} logo small in corner

craft.notes: One number per slide, growing slide by slide, so the swipe itself feels like compounding. Use plain addition the viewer can check in their head. The props repeat the same object in larger quantities so the math is visible even with the sound off.

do_not: Use made-up compound interest or return figures
Imply the habit guarantees a health or money outcome
Cram more than one number onto a slide
compliance: Financial advisors and insurance: show only simple arithmetic, never projected returns, growth rates or income promises; add the firm's required disclosure
Fitness: present time totals only, no weight-loss or health outcome guarantees
